corrected_draft.title: HHS Removes 17 Members From CDC Vaccine Advisory Committee
corrected_draft.description_short: HHS said it removed ACIP’s 17 sitting members on June 9, 2025 and would replace them with members under consideration.
corrected_draft.description_medium: On June 9, 2025, HHS announced it had removed all 17 sitting members of the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices and would replace them with new members then under consideration. The committee advises CDC on vaccine safety, efficacy, and clinical need. The HHS announcement supports a discrete membership action but contradicts the held entry’s February 10 date.
corrected_draft.description_long: On June 9, 2025, the Department of Health and Human Services announced that it had removed the 17 sitting members of the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices and would replace them with new members then under consideration. ACIP advises the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention on vaccine safety, efficacy, and clinical need. HHS said the action was taken under Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and described it as a total reconstitution of the committee. HHS also said ACIP would next meet June 25 through 27 at CDC headquarters in Atlanta. The announcement establishes the date and scope of the membership change. It does not support the held entry’s February 10 date; that date should be removed. The corrected record should attribute HHS’s stated rationale to the department and distinguish it from independent assessment of the committee’s scientific role or the effects of the membership change.
